notes.title: MotoGP™22 available now!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=uVRFP4IiY20;full][/previewyoutube]
Feel the emotions of the greatest champions and the most-celebrated bikes in the most authentic MotoGP experience ever. The new chapter of MotoGP™22 is a whole new story, and it's available now!

notes.title: The Art of Racing
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=ptYyim8BYY4;full][/previewyoutube]
Everybody deserves a chance to shine! Learn the basics or perfect your style with the Revised Tutorials, new MotoGP™Academy, and new Riding Analysis System. Thanks to the new training tools of MotoGP™22, the next champion could be you!

notes.title: Next-Gen Gameplay
notes.notes:
We are happy to show you the first Official MotoGP™22 Gameplay! Take a look at what we have in store for you, including a brand new split-screen mode to engage in epic battles side by side with your friends and family! The challenge just got even more exciting with MotoGP™22!
[previewyoutube=Degr5nFRKGc;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: NINE SEASON 2009 is here!
notes.notes:
Miss the old good days? We've got you covered! Live again one of the most unforgettable years of MotoGP™ history with the NINE SEASON 2009. An exclusive documentary and 17 playable challenges to race in the boots of legendary riders and relive the iconic moments of season 2009!
[previewyoutube=Ma6jaUWaSwU;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Announcement trailer
notes.notes:
Start your engines! The most immersive and realistic chapter of MotoGP™ videogame history will be available on April 21st, with amazing news! This year, MotoGP™22 will make you live again all the emotions of the legendary season 2009 and its greatest riders!
